verdict.rationale: The core skill lifecycle is reachable programmatically. Skills can be uploaded and managed through the Skills API, versioned via the Skill Versions API, and attached to Messages API requests through the `container` parameter (up to 20 per request). The Agent SDK can also load plugins and skills, control which skills a session may invoke, and dispatch them by name. Nothing in the evidence shows explicit API parity with the Claude.ai UI, where the example skills are offered to paid plans, and the API imposes a per-request skill cap. Missing for 10: documented UI↔API parity (e.g., enabling/disabling and sharing skills as in Claude.ai), independent hands-on confirmation of Skills API management, absence of API-only limits like the 20-skill cap.
